name: mentionly-monorepo
description: Monorepo for mentionly: framework-agnostic core plus Vue, React and Svelte adapters

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/vue build && bun run --cwd packages/mentionly build && bun run --cwd packages/react build && bun run --cwd packages/svelte build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/vue typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/mentionly typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/react typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/svelte typecheck && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:examples: bun run --cwd examples/react build && bun run --cwd examples/svelte build
